client.name: Discord Integration
changes: As a reminder, in Discord supported regions, you can now connect your Riot and Discord accounts to jump into game with your Discord friends faster. Linking your accounts lets you invite Discord friends straight into your party, copy a lobby link to share with your server, or see which of your friends are playing so you can get into a lobby with them.
You can connect your Riot and Discord accounts in the League client, through Discord, from your account page.

client.name: Ranked
changes: Ranked 5s are back. On June 26, Ranked 5s will be live at 8 pm! Tournament Draft, double the stakes, no restrictions on who can play with each other, and unique rewards.

client.name: Reporting
changes: Player DMs have long been a gap in our reporting coverage, which has allowed bad actors to use direct messages as a place for chat toxicity with impunity. We are closing that loophole in this patch by adding a report menu directly into your chat interface. You can report and/or block a player at the same time by selecting the report button on the chat header, right-clicking the chat dialogue to summon the context menu, or from the block menu. Blocking a player means that DMs can no longer be exchanged. However, message history will persist during the same session after blocking or being blocked, so that players can no longer abuse the block function as a way to avoid being reported.

Once reported, we'll be able to view both sides of the conversation and take action where appropriate. All reported direct message data is handled securely and used strictly for moderation purposes. While we hope you don't have to use this feature often, this tool ensures accountability extends to all player communications in League

game.name: Last Hit Indicators
changes: We're going to be enabling Last Hit Indicators for Normal Draftgames. This feature has been live in Swiftplay & Co-op vs. AI for a while, and we've seen it result in new players being more successful at last-hitting than before. These players are now graduating into Normals & Ranked and are interested in continuing to use them.

Innate: Locke's basic attacks deal 5 – 40 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit , increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's missing health) , up to 10 – 80 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) .

Active: Locke hurls a nail in the target direction that deals 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies hit, slows them by 25% for 1 second, and applies a stack of Soul Nails for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Against targets with at least 2 Soul Nails stacks, the slow is increased to 60% and lasts for 2 seconds. Ritual Nails can be recast twice more within 5 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 0. 5 -second static cooldown between casts.

Recast: Locke mimics the first cast's effects. For each recast not used when Ritual Nails ends, 20% – 35% (based on level) of the ability's cooldown and mana cost is refunded, up to a 40% – 70% (based on level) refund for two remaining recasts.

Locke's next damaging basic attack or Ashen Pursuit against an enemy with Soul Nails stacks consumes them all to deal 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 (+ 25 / 27. 5 / 30 / 32. 5 / 35% AP) bonus magic damage for each stack. This damage is increased by 20% and 40% for two and three Soul Nails stacks respectively.
Cost: 70 mana.
Cooldown: 10 / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 seconds.
Cast Time: 0. 25 seconds, Target Range: 950, Width: 100.

Active: Locke ignites his soul for 6 seconds, gaining 40% – 70% (based on level) bonus attack speed and 40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed for the duration, with the latter decaying to 20% over 1 second after 1. 5 seconds have elapsed. While active, Locke also stores 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+ 120% AP) of grey health on his health bar equal to 100% of the post-mitigation damage he takes from enemy champions , up to a cap, plus the total amount of health lost from Soul Ignition's health cost . This is increased by up to 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) based on his missing health and Soul Ignition's elapsed duration.
After 0. 5 seconds, Soul Ignition can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
Recast: Locke ends Soul Ignition and consumes his current grey health to heal for the same amount.
Soul Ignition's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control .

Active: Locke throws a totem artifact that travels to the target location over 0. 5 seconds. After a 0. 25 -second delay of its landing, the totem rises into the air and fires latching nails onto all enemies around it, dealing them 150 / 225 / 300 (+ 60% AP) magic damage , slowing them by 99% decaying over 2 seconds, and marking enemy champions hit for 5 seconds. Marked enemies are executed below 10 / 11 / 12% (+ 0. 5 % per Sealed Champion stack) of their maximum health . Successful executions refresh the duration of the mark on all affected targets.

At the end of the mark's duration, if at least one champion was executed, the totem seals away the souls of all executed champions and drops itself onto the ground, both over 2. 25 seconds. It then remains on the ground for a duration equal to Purgatory's remaining cooldown , but for no less than 10 seconds. Locke can retrieve it by moving near it. Upon retrieving the totem, Purgatory's current cooldown is reduced by 20% for each champion sealed, and Locke gains a Sealed Champion stack per champion.
